phrases.head: The exposition of His word — exalted is His praise —: "the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful" (al-Raḥmān al-Raḥīm).
The statement concerning the explanation of His word: رَبِّ (Lord).
The discourse on the explanation of His statement: الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ ("The Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate").

phrases.text: Master of the Day of Judgment
phrases.head: Statement on the explanation of His word: مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ (Master of the Day of Judgment).

phrases.text: You ˹alone˺ we worship and You ˹alone˺ we ask for help
phrases.head: The statement concerning the explanation of His saying, exalted is His praise: إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ ("You alone we worship").

phrases.text: Guide us along the Straight Path
phrases.head: The explanation of His word: اهْدِنَا ("Guide us").

phrases.text: the Path of those You have blessed
not those You are displeased with,
